question.text: The minimum application value for a retail investor in a book-built IPO is in the range of:

explanation.text: The Logic: In a book-built offer, investors must bid for the minimum bid lot so that the minimum application value adheres to the SEBI prescribed range of Rs. 10,000 to Rs. 15,000. The Trap: The exact application amount depends on the bid lot size and price band. SEBI sets the range, not the exact amount. Cross-Exam Context: IPO application requirements are tested in X-A (Ch 6) and IX.
